not_verified_on_staging_reason: This lane adds three migration files, a Jest source check, a pgTAP file, read-only check SQL and rollbacks. Nothing is applied from the PR: each file is applied later through RUN-MIGRATION.yml, one file per dispatch, after the owner approves the files and the target database (collaboration.md section 7d). Staging shares the production database, and nothing deployed calls send_message, send_message_as or reads chat_messages.scope (the gateway lane messaging-send-gateway ships later behind mt.network_enabled), so the staging deploy runs no code that reads anything new. Staging writes to the production Supabase project (rules 31/31b/48), so the RPCs are never called there: they are proven by the pgTAP file on a local stack. The post-apply check is read-only: docs/validation/VTID-05576/live-before.sql before, post-apply-checks.sql after, rollback-check.sql after a rollback, run by Kiro through RUN-MIGRATION's read-only check. No suite points at vitanaland.com.
